# =====================================================================
# CWIC news relevance - which countries receive a broadcast (major = yes) event.
#
# Generated by  python _tools/news_tiers/build_news_tiers.py  - every
# `major = yes` event gets a show_major using one trigger below. The CSV
# (_tools/news_tiers/news_tiers.csv) picks the tier; the builder picks the
# variant automatically from the event's script:
#
#   CWIC_news_<tier>     event has no effects: humans only. AI never needs a
#                        popup with nothing in it, so it is not sent to them.
#   CWIC_news_<tier>_fx  event has effects: every AI still receives it, so
#                        effects run exactly as before. Any tag an option is
#                        gated to is added to show_major by the builder.
#   Events whose effects apply to whoever receives them are forced to world_fx.
#
# Cost: is_ai is always the first check, so ~all countries settle on one
# cheap trigger. No-effect events now create ~1 event instance instead of
# one per country.
#
# show_major scope: THIS = receiver, FROM = country that fired the event.
#   world     everyone
#   regional  involved with FROM, or capital on FROM's continent  (default)
#   local     involved with FROM only
# =====================================================================

CWIC_news_world = {
	is_ai = no
}
CWIC_news_regional = {
	is_ai = no
	OR = {
		CWIC_news_involved_with_FROM = yes
		CWIC_news_same_continent_as_FROM = yes
	}
}
CWIC_news_local = {
	is_ai = no
	CWIC_news_involved_with_FROM = yes
}

CWIC_news_world_fx = {
	always = yes
}
CWIC_news_regional_fx = {
	OR = {
		is_ai = yes
		CWIC_news_involved_with_FROM = yes
		CWIC_news_same_continent_as_FROM = yes
	}
}
CWIC_news_local_fx = {
	OR = {
		is_ai = yes
		CWIC_news_involved_with_FROM = yes
	}
}

# THIS = receiver, FROM = firer.
CWIC_news_involved_with_FROM = {
	OR = {
		tag = FROM
		has_war_with = FROM
		is_in_faction_with = FROM
		is_subject_of = FROM
		FROM = { is_subject_of = PREV }
		is_neighbor_of = FROM
	}
}

CWIC_news_same_continent_as_FROM = {
	OR = {
		AND = { capital_scope = { is_on_continent = europe }        FROM = { capital_scope = { is_on_continent = europe } } }
		AND = { capital_scope = { is_on_continent = north_america } FROM = { capital_scope = { is_on_continent = north_america } } }
		AND = { capital_scope = { is_on_continent = south_america } FROM = { capital_scope = { is_on_continent = south_america } } }
		AND = { capital_scope = { is_on_continent = australia }     FROM = { capital_scope = { is_on_continent = australia } } }
		AND = { capital_scope = { is_on_continent = africa }        FROM = { capital_scope = { is_on_continent = africa } } }
		AND = { capital_scope = { is_on_continent = asia }          FROM = { capital_scope = { is_on_continent = asia } } }
		AND = { capital_scope = { is_on_continent = middle_east }   FROM = { capital_scope = { is_on_continent = middle_east } } }
	}
}

# Same rules for super events, where ROOT = firer (see CWIC_Super_Event_Triggers.txt).
# Only evaluated for human players.
CWIC_news_relevant_to_ROOT = {
	OR = {
		tag = ROOT
		has_war_with = ROOT
		is_in_faction_with = ROOT
		is_subject_of = ROOT
		ROOT = { is_subject_of = PREV }
		is_neighbor_of = ROOT
		AND = { capital_scope = { is_on_continent = europe }        ROOT = { capital_scope = { is_on_continent = europe } } }
		AND = { capital_scope = { is_on_continent = north_america } ROOT = { capital_scope = { is_on_continent = north_america } } }
		AND = { capital_scope = { is_on_continent = south_america } ROOT = { capital_scope = { is_on_continent = south_america } } }
		AND = { capital_scope = { is_on_continent = australia }     ROOT = { capital_scope = { is_on_continent = australia } } }
		AND = { capital_scope = { is_on_continent = africa }        ROOT = { capital_scope = { is_on_continent = africa } } }
		AND = { capital_scope = { is_on_continent = asia }          ROOT = { capital_scope = { is_on_continent = asia } } }
		AND = { capital_scope = { is_on_continent = middle_east }   ROOT = { capital_scope = { is_on_continent = middle_east } } }
	}
}
